to.shell_command: pgrep -xq OmniWM && osascript -e 'quit app "OmniWM"' || open -a OmniWM
omniwmctl command focus previous || omniwmctl command switch-workspace back-and-forth
omniwmctl command consume-window-into-column || omniwmctl command move up
omniwmctl command expel-window-from-column || omniwmctl command move down
omniwmctl command consume-or-expel-window-left || omniwmctl command move left
omniwmctl command consume-or-expel-window-right || omniwmctl command move right
omniwmctl command set-container-primary-span +10% || omniwmctl command resize-focused grow
omniwmctl command set-container-primary-span -10% || omniwmctl command resize-focused shrink
osascript -e 'quit app "OmniWM"'; while pgrep -xq OmniWM; do sleep 0.2; done; open -a OmniWM && osascript -e 'display notification with title "restarted omniwm"'
osascript -e 'quit app "OmniWM"'; while pgrep -xq OmniWM; do sleep 0.2; done; open -a OmniWM && osascript -e 'display notification with title "restarted omniwm"'
cd ~/.config/karabiner-config/ && npm install && npm run update && npm run build && osascript -e 'display notification with title "reloaded karabiner config"'
